exec azk init

exec azk secret set db-pass --value hunter2 --content-type text/plain --tag env=prod
stderr 'Stored db-pass version 1'
stdin value.txt
exec azk secret set db-pass
stderr 'Stored db-pass version 2'
exec azk secret set api --from value.txt

exec azk secret get db-pass
stdout '^hunter3\n$'
exec azk secret get db-pass --version 1
stdout '^hunter2$'
! stdout hunter3
exec azk --json secret get db-pass --version 1
stdout '"content_type": "text/plain"'
stdout '"value": "hunter2"'
exec azk secret get api -o out.txt
cmp out.txt value.txt

exec azk secret list
stdout 'api +secret +active'
stdout 'db-pass +secret +active +.*env=prod'
exec azk key list
! stdout db-pass
exec azk secret show db-pass
stdout 'Kind:     secret'
stdout '  2 '
stdout '  1 '
! stdout hunter

# Secrets and keys are different things.
! exec azk key rotate db-pass
stderr 'rotated with'
! exec azk secret get nokey
stderr 'not found'
exec azk key generate k --type oct
! exec azk secret get k
stderr 'not a secret'
! exec azk secret set k --value x
stderr 'not a secret'

exec azk secret delete db-pass
! exec azk secret get db-pass
stderr 'is deleted'
! exec azk secret set db-pass --value x
stderr 'is deleted'
exec azk secret recover db-pass
exec azk secret get db-pass
stdout hunter3

-- value.txt --
hunter3
